title: Contact
intro: For publishing, press, collaboration, rights, or platform inquiries, use this page as the public routing point for Star Splitter Visions. A permanent contact address will be published when the approved public channel is ready.

cards.title: Publishing and collaboration
cards.body: Include the series, release, or workstream you are asking about, along with the purpose of the inquiry and any relevant timing.

cards.title: Press and coverage
cards.body: For reviews, interviews, coverage, or media requests, include the outlet, intended use, requested materials, and deadline.
